Partial |type = Immunity |immunities = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Collision]]CollisionWhat units it cannot collide with depends on the enemy. }} ==Description== '''Collision Immunity''' was an immunity that made the enemy fully or partially immune to unit collision. It has been replaced by [[Flying]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] attributes. ==Mechanics== Enemies with the '''Collision Immunity''' were immune to collisions with units (like [[Military Base]] vehicles, [[Crook Boss]] units and the [[Shotgunner|Enforcer]]'s [[SWAT Van]]). No collision would occur, and the enemy and unit would not be harmed. Some enemies with the ''Collision Immunity'' were only immune to some collisions, while other were immune to all of them. Enemies with this immunity were not immune to any other type of damage that came from these units. ==Enemy List== The following event enemies had ''Collision Immunity'': *[[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] ([[Nightmare Carnival]]) *[[Witch (Nightmare Carnival)|Witch]] ([[Nightmare Carnival]], [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]] only) ==Update History== *'''18 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.1|Release v1.1.0]] **'''Collision Immunity''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Collision Immunity''' removed, replaced by [[Flying]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] attributes. ==Notes== {{AttributeNavBox}}
